status.description: completed: every hypothesis was screened (see admitted, rejected, deferred). invalid_input: the call itself was unusable (bad study_id, run_id, tpu_version, limits, repo_root or payload) and nothing was screened. failed: the study store could not be read or written, e.g. the study was never started.

study_id.description: The study_id the call was made with, echoed as given (an invalid one is why status is invalid_input).

request_id.description: The call's run_id, or a generated one when none was passed. Stamped on each bank hypothesis entry and on the hypotheses_admitted study event.

admitted.description: Hypotheses whose arms are now open in study.json, in the order given. Warnings never block; read and act on them: no_gain_estimate, low_expected_gain, unverified_profile_ops, inflated_profile_share, hardware:..., overlaps_active_arm:<arm ids>.

arms.description: One arm per variant, or one arm named after the hypothesis when it has no variants.

fingerprint.description: evaluate_arm.compute_arm_fingerprint of kind and merged target_parameters (kind and claim when there are none).

rejected.description: Hypotheses not admitted, each with every objective reason found: invalid_shape, unknown_field:<name>, missing_field:<name>, invalid_id, invalid_kind, no_evidence, out_of_range:<share|headroom>, code_ref_outside_repo:<path>, missing_code_ref:<path>, duplicate_arm_id:<arm>, duplicate_recipe:<arm>, duplicate_variant_suffix:<suffix>, duplicate_hypothesis_id:<id>, evicted_by_arm_cap. A reason is a machine-readable code, optionally :<arg>, then ': ' and a detail.

hypothesis_id.description: The proposal's id, or #<index> when it has no usable id.

deferred.description: Valid hypotheses that did not fit this call's max_new_arms budget. Nothing was written for them; resubmit them on the next call.

open_arms.description: Open plus in_flight arms in study.json after the call.

hypotheses.description: The proposals echoed with known keys only; a proposal too malformed to read is omitted. This is the one definition of the hypothesis item that the researcher writes to --hypotheses-json.

id.description: Stable hypothesis id. It is the arm id when there are no variants, and the prefix of <id>-<suffix> when there are.

kind.description: Bottleneck kind, one of study.BOTTLENECK_KINDS (the kind enum of study-round.json arms). Required because every study-round.json arm requires a kind and the round routes execution by it. Not an enum here so this schema cannot drift from the framework list; hypothesis_bank.py rejects any other value as invalid_kind.

claim.description: One line: what the arm asserts would help. Becomes the study arm's claim.

details.description: The reasoning: why you believe the claim.

targeted_roofline.description: Open object. Suggested keys: bound (compute|hbm|vmem|ici|host|latency), current, target, note.

evidence.description: What the claim rests on. At least one item: hypothesis_bank.py rejects a missing or empty list as no_evidence. type is free-form; documented values are xprof, trace, hlo-op, code, sharding, config, prior-arm, kb and doc. ref is a link, a path, file.py:L120-L180, a symbol, an op name or an arm id. hlo-op refs are checked against --profile-summary-json when one is given.

code_refs.description: Where the change lands: files, line ranges or symbols, including sharding and config files. path is relative to --repo-root; with --repo-root, a path that escapes it (code_ref_outside_repo) or does not exist (missing_code_ref) is rejected. Also used to warn about open or in_flight arms touching the same files, and by parallel workers to claim disjoint work.

share.description: Measured fraction of step or request time in this bottleneck, as on study-round.json arms. Copied onto every arm.

headroom.description: Fraction of share this change can remove, as on study-round.json arms. Copied onto every arm. With share it is your ranking signal: study.arm_expected_gain (share * headroom, or headroom alone for memory-capacity and recompilation-padding when share is 0) orders claim_arm and decides which open arm the arm cap evicts first. A missing value counts as 0.

target_parameters.description: Open object: the recipe. With kind it forms the arm fingerprint used to reject duplicate recipes.

epp_config.description: Optional distributed-serving (llm-d) EndpointPickerConfig and LeaderWorkerSet recipe parameters. Merged with target_parameters into the arm fingerprint.

variants.description: One hypothesis, several arms. Each variant becomes arm <id>-<suffix>, with its claim (default '<claim> [<suffix>]') and its target_parameters merged over the hypothesis's. All arms of a hypothesis are admitted together or not at all.

summary.description: One line of counts: admitted, rejected, deferred, open arms.

error.description: Why the call was invalid_input or failed.
